# 1.9 Generated files

> [!info] Navigation
> Index: [[Specification Index]] · Parent: [[1 Repository conventions]]
> Prev: [[1.8 Documentation]] · Next: [[1.10 Naming]]

## Purpose

Keeps reproducible artifacts out of the source tree.

## Outline

- [x] artifacts are not source
- [x] exclusion mechanism

## Content

Generated build artifacts MUST NOT be treated as repository source.

Build directories, compiler outputs, generated documentation, temporary archives,
and other reproducible artifacts SHOULD remain outside the canonical source tree
or be excluded through repository ignore rules.
